title: Uniform Remix 솔로 #200 · 교복 · 여름 하복 셔츠 × 치어리더 플레어 초미니 · 플랫 흰 캔버스 스니커즈+발목 양말 · apex siren · 와이드 스탠스 · 배경 고층빌딩 광장 · 걸크러시
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 30s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail balayage hair — wearing a skin-tight micro summer school uniform set, a cropped short-sleeve button-style shirt of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with a thin sky-blue line at each cuff and a loosened navy tie hanging from an open collar, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the modal jersey fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro flared cheerleader skirt of ultra-thin matte pale-blue modal jersey with a white trim along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones and flaring outward with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones, the matching micro briefs of the same fabric peeking beneath the hem. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the loosened navy tie, the sky-blue cuff lines and the flared cheerleader skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing in a wide stance facing the camera straight on, both hands resting on her flared hips, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: clean white low-top canvas sneakers with white rubber toe caps and white laces tied in neat bows, worn with short white ankle socks folded at the ankle, her feet planted flat on the floor.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so her full height reads at a glance, her shoes planted flat on the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
